📚 MLSU B.Sc./B.Ed. 1st Year Mathematics – Geometry 2024 का पूरा पेपर Solution इस वीडियो में दिया गया है। ✨

अगर आप MLSU B.Sc./B.Ed. Mathematics 2024 के Geometry Paper की तैयारी कर रहे हैं, तो यह वीडियो आपके लिए बहुत उपयोगी है। इस वीडियो में पूरे प्रश्नपत्र के सभी महत्वपूर्ण problems को step-by-step और आसान तरीके से solve किया गया है। ✅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 इस वीडियो में क्या पढ़ाया गया है?
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔹 Part-A के सभी प्रश्नों के उत्तर
🔹 Part-B के सभी महत्वपूर्ण questions के comprehensive solutions
🔹 Part-C के long-answer questions के detailed solutions
🔹 Conics के important problems
🔹 Ellipse और Hyperbola
🔹 Asymptotes
🔹 Normal और Tangent
🔹 Pole & Polar
🔹 Focal Chord और Directrix
🔹 3D Geometry
🔹 Angle between Planes
🔹 Pair of Planes
🔹 Straight Lines in 3D
🔹 Sphere
🔹 Right Circular Cone
🔹 Conicoid
🔹 Tangent Planes
🔹 Central Conicoid
🔹 Cylinder
🔹 Triangular Prism
🔹 Section of Conicoid तथा Axes

📌 इस paper में total 16 questions दिए गए हैं और इस video में पूरे question paper को cover किया गया है।

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS:
00:00 – Introduction and Paper Overview (Maths-III: Geometry)
00:44 – Part A: Short Questions
00:47 – Q1: Find the center of the conic
05:46 – Q2: Equation of the normal to an ellipse
06:45 – Q3: Find the equation of a hyperbola
09:23 – Q4: Polar equation of the tangent to a conic
10:32 – Q5: Angle between two planes
12:48 – Q6: Condition for a line to lie in a plane
14:19 – Q7: Equation of sphere OABC
15:55 – Q8: Condition for a cone to have three perpendicular tangent planes
17:30 – Q9: Tangent plane to a central conicoid
18:48 – Q10: Definition of a Diametral Plane
19:40 – Part B: Unit-wise Detailed Solutions
19:43 – Q2: Asymptotes and conjugate hyperbola
32:17 – Q3: Proving a line is normal to an ellipse
39:27 – Q4: Locus of poles of circle tangents w.r.t. a parabola
45:47 – Q5: Tangents at ends of a focal chord intersect on the directrix
50:51 – Q6: Representing a pair of planes and finding the angle between them
59:29 – Q7: Finding a line parallel to a given line intersecting two others
01:12:13 – Q8: Sphere with center at origin touching a given line
01:20:15 – Q9: Equation of a right circular cone
01:27:42 – Q10: Tangent planes to a conicoid passing through a line
01:38:29 – Q11: Locus of chords of a central conicoid bisected at a point
01:49:01 – Part C: Advanced Problems
01:49:04 – Q12: Locus of intersection of ellipse tangents at an angle alpha
01:59:52 – Q13: Locus of poles of normal chords of a hyperbola
02:08:04 – Q14: Proving planes form a triangular prism and finding its axis
02:19:06 – Q15: Equation of a right circular cylinder with a guiding circle
02:27:20 – Q16: Length and direction cosines of axes of a conicoid section
02:40:07 – Conclusion and Exam Preparation Tips

📌 अगर आप MLSU B.Sc. Mathematics की सम्पूर्ण तैयारी करना चाहते हैं,
तो हमारे चैनल को अभी Subscribe करें।
